Joshua David Steven King (born 3 January 2007) is an English professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Premier League club Fulham.
Early life
King was educated at Hampton School in West London.
Club career
King joined the Fulham academy aged eight and in January 2024 signed his first professional contract with Fulham.
On 27 August 2024, King made his professional club debut coming on as a second-half substitute in an EFL Cup game against Birmingham City. On 5 December 2024, he made his first Premier League appearance in a victory over Brighton & Hove Albion.
International career
In August 2022 King captained England under-16 against Italy.
